decision_record.calculation: Fixture chain long 2.90/3.00, wing 1.10/1.20: mid credit 1.80 vs market-cross credit 1.70 -> spread_saved_ps = 0.10/share = $10/package on every exit; limit at mid refuses fills below the mid instead of crossing.
decision_record.comparison: Baseline exit: market order, price_hint = position cost basis (avg_price) — not a market price at all. Comparator: same exit trigger, chain-priced package: control cross = bid(long) - ask(short) = 1.70/share on the fixture chain; treatment limit = package mid = (2.95 - 1.15) = 1.80/share.
decision_record.experiment: tests/test_harden_edge_batch11_blockers.py TestVertExitMid: all four books exit limit@1.80 with paired record when the chain prices both legs; unpriceable chain keeps the exact pre-change market exit; switch OFF restores market/avg_price-hint exactly. Rejection rule: any exit whose limit exceeds the executable cross or fires without both legs priced.
decision_record.mechanism: Execution (unpriced exit): a market exit on a two-leg vertical pays the whole spread; the intent's price_hint misstates the expected proceeds as cost.
decision_record.transfer: The VWAP20 recovery vertical's surplus is a 5-session mean-reversion capture; crossing the full quoted spread twice (entry cured by batch 10, exit not) donates a fixed slice of that capture to the spread on every round trip.

disposition: ENHANCED: exit limit at package mid (entries already cured by batch-10 ENH-ASTERB2-MIDLIMIT)
